name: Dimmer Switch
description: An in-wall dimmer switch that controls its light locally and can be controlled remotely by Insteon keypads, remotes, sensors, or the Hub. It is rated for up to 150 W of LED or 600 W of incandescent lighting.
notes: The 2015 owner's manual for the 2477S, 2477D and 2477DH prints subcategory 0x00, a template value; Insteon Device Categories (January 2014) gives the 2477D 0x01/0x20.
